news.zh: TARIC 11-12 快照：Q4 已用 54.2%，较 11-10 新增消耗 11.35 万吨；用尽 58 个、临界 30 个。韩国集中放量：镀层板 09.9837 消耗 21,098 吨、热卷 09.9806 消耗 20,525 吨；FTA 配额 – CSQ 中厚板 09.9509 进入临界。
news.en: TARIC 11-12 snapshot: Q4 54.2% used, 0.11 million tonnes drawn since 11-10; 58 orders exhausted, 30 critical. Korea drew heavily: coated sheet 09.9837 21,098 t, HRC 09.9806 20,525 t; FTA CSQ quarto plate 09.9509 turned critical.

news.zh: TARIC 11-10 快照：Q4 已用 52.1%，较 11-06 新增消耗 5.57 万吨；用尽 57 个、临界 30 个。瑞士线材/盘条 09.9904 用尽；韩国中厚板 09.9854 消耗 7,384 吨、剩 6,765 吨，进入临界；英国热卷 09.9705 消耗 5,267 吨。
news.en: TARIC 11-10 snapshot: Q4 52.1% used, 55.7 kt drawn since 11-06; 57 orders exhausted, 30 critical. Switzerland wire rod 09.9904 is exhausted; Korea quarto plate 09.9854 drew 7,384 t (6,765 t left) and turned critical; UK HRC 09.9705 drew 5,267 t.

news.zh: TARIC 11-06 快照：Q4 已用 51.0%，较 11-05 单日多用 1.77 万吨。塞尔维亚热卷 09.9809 用掉 2,284 吨，印度镀层板 09.9835 用掉 2,128 吨、剩 1.06 万吨；瑞士线材 09.9904 只剩 1,350 吨。用尽 56 个，临界 29 个
news.en: TARIC 6 Nov snapshot: Q4 is 51.0% used, with 17.7 kt drawn since 5 Nov; Serbia HRC 09.9809 drew 2.3 kt and India coated sheet 09.9835 2.1 kt (10.6 kt left); Switzerland wire rod 09.9904 is down to 1,350 t. 56 orders exhausted, 29 critical

news.zh: TARIC 11-05 快照：Q4 已用 50.7%，较 11-03 再升 3.3 个百分点，两天多用 17.74 万吨；越南镀层板 09.9832 用掉 1.84 万吨，韩国热卷 09.9806 用掉 1.67 万吨。越南热卷 09.9807、瑞士线材 09.9904 进入临界。用尽 56 个，临界 29 个
news.en: TARIC 5 Nov snapshot: Q4 is 50.7% used, up 3.3 points from 3 Nov with another 177.4 kt drawn; Vietnam coated sheet 09.9832 drew 18.4 kt and Korea HRC 09.9806 16.7 kt. Vietnam HRC 09.9807 and Switzerland wire rod 09.9904 turned critical. 56 orders exhausted, 29 critical

news.zh: TARIC 11-03 快照：Q4 已用 47.4%，较 10-30 多用 6.97 万吨；中国螺纹钢 09.9888 用掉 4,702 吨，结转余额几近耗尽，仅剩 25 吨；韩国镀层板 09.9837 用掉 1.12 万吨。用尽 54 个（新增 09.9746 FTA 其他国家燃气管），临界 27 个
news.en: TARIC 3 Nov snapshot: Q4 is 47.4% used, with another 69.7 kt drawn since 30 Oct; China rebar 09.9888 drew 4.7 kt and its carried-over balance is nearly gone (25 t left); Korea coated sheet 09.9837 drew 11.2 kt. 54 orders exhausted (new: 09.9746 FTA-other gas pipes), 27 critical
